name: KPI 1: High-risk zones correctly prioritised (Precision@K)
definition: Of top-5 zones ranked by flood probability, fraction that truly flood
method: Rank test set by predicted probability, take top K=5, compute fraction with true Flood=1.
interpretation: Top-5 ranked test locations contain 100.0% true floods; emergency triage is well prioritised.

name: KPI 2: Recall (high-risk class)
definition: Of all flood events in the test set, how many did the model correctly identify?
method: Test set, final model at tuned threshold.
interpretation: Model catches 93.1% of floods; missed-flood risk is within tolerance.

name: KPI 3: F1-score (high-risk class)
definition: Harmonic mean of precision and recall, balancing false alarms and missed events.
method: Test set, final model at tuned threshold.
interpretation: F1=0.867 with precision=0.810, recall=0.931; balance of alarms vs misses is acceptable.

name: KPI 4: Data completeness after preprocessing
definition: Percentage of non-null cells in the processed feature set.

name: KPI 5: Prediction response time
definition: Average time (ms) to preprocess one location and generate a flood probability.
method: Timed batch of 200 single-row predictions (raw input -> probability).
interpretation: Average 4.48 ms per location; suitable for real-time triage.
